scientific_integrity: Analytic proof gives all-size/all-time statements. Reproducible exact-rational code checks representative instances and arithmetic; this is same-model scientific review only, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted complete bipartite graphs, real signals, homogeneous degree-normalized heat, and unweighted complete-pair Gini variation only. The fixed-size constant is an exact finite maximization; no closed count-maximizer classification is claimed. An unindexed equivalent antecedent remains possible.
title: A sharp uniform Gini-decay envelope for normalized heat on complete bipartite graphs
